summary: Oklahoma couple's ATV went end-over-end ~300 ft down a gully after creeping over the edge of Corkscrew Pass road; both survived — wife litter-raised to the road and flown by helicopter, husband taken by ambulance.
responding_agency: Ouray Mountain Rescue Team; medical helicopter
notes: Saturday morning during monthly training so response was rapid. Five-point harnesses/roll cage credited for survival. Wife flown from Ironton staging area, husband to Montrose hospital.
